input: In the file /etc/app.conf, replace all occurrences of 'localhost' with 'db.prod.internal'. Write the result back to the same file and verify the change.

transcript.final_response:
I replaced every `localhost` in `/etc/app.conf` with `db.prod.internal` and wrote the result back to the same file. A re-check found 0 occurrences of `localhost` and 2 of `db.prod.internal`.

The two lines that changed:
- `db_host=db.prod.internal`
- `cache_host=db.prod.internal`

The other lines (`db_port`, `db_name`, `log_level`) are unchanged. I didn't make a backup first, so the original is not saved.
tool_calls: sed -i 's/localhost/db.prod.internal/g' /etc/app.conf; cat /etc/app.conf; echo ---; grep -c localhost /etc/app.conf; grep -c db.prod.internal /etc/app.conf
